description: ISOCAM, the ISO camera: spectral transmission R = T x Q (filter transmission x detector quantum efficiency) of the 11 short-wave (SW1-SW11) and 10 long-wave (LW1-LW10) broad-band filters, from the ISO Handbook Vol. II (CAM), Appendix A, Figures A.1 and A.2.
short_description: ISOCAM (ISO camera) SW1-SW11 and LW1-LW10 broad-band filters
facility_description: The Infrared Space Observatory (ISO) was an ESA infrared space telescope; ISOCAM was its camera (ISO Handbook Vol. II: 'CAM - The ISO Camera', Blommaert, Siebenmorgen, Coulais et al., ESA SP-1262, SAI-99-057/Dc Version 2.0, June 2003).

links.label: The ISO Handbook, Volume II: CAM (ESA SP-1262), Appendix A Colour Corrections, Figures A.1-A.2

notes: Curves read from the vector figures A.1 (SW) and A.2 (LW) on PDF page 114 of the ISO Handbook Vol. II: IDL plots whose labels are stroked lines, so the x-axis end values of each panel were read from the rendered page and checked against the positions of the major tick marks in code; the y axis is 0-1 between the frame edges. Each curve is the plotted polyline (no smoothing or resampling). The handbook says the numeric curves are in the CAL-G files CCGSWSPEC/CCGLWSPEC, which are not publicly downloadable. Pivot wavelengths agree with SVO's ISO/ISO.* copies within 0.02 %, except LW1 (+0.48 %) whose curve agrees with SVO's point by point; the difference is in SVO's recorded pivot. DetectorType photon from the handbook's colour correction (Eq. A.1 weights R(lambda) by lambda). ISOCAM CVF curves are not in the handbook in numeric or vector form and are not built here.
